legacyOptions.expr: (max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) - max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"} offset 1m)) > 0

spec.expr: (max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) - max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"} offset 1m)) > 0

description: Preheat, propagation, rescue, mirror and image cleanup for Angry Duck 1.8.7. Pick data source → cluster → node; click any node, image or row to focus.

spec.description: Nodes with an Angry Duck worker exposing metrics.
spec.title: Workers Reporting

spec.expr: sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result=~"local|peer"}[$__range])) / sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))

spec.description: One row per node over the selected time range: cleanup state, mirror hit ratio, bytes the mirror delivered, bytes served to other nodes, registry pulls, stuck images, cleanup candidates and images removed. Click a node to focus on it.
spec.title: Node Overview

spec.description: Running containers whose repo was preheated on that node recently: a rough signal that preheat lands where pods actually run.
spec.title: Running Containers from Preheated Repos

spec.expr: sum by (result) (sum_over_time((clamp_min(angryduck_controller_pull_orders_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", registry=~"$registry"} - angryduck_controller_pull_orders_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", registry=~"$registry"} offset ${scrape_interval}, 0))[$__interval:${scrape_interval}]))

spec.description: Pull orders the controller sent to seed workers, per interval.
spec.title: Seed Pull Orders by Result

spec.expr: sum by (node) (sum_over_time((clamp_min(angryduck_controller_pull_orders_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", registry=~"$registry"} - angryduck_controller_pull_orders_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", registry=~"$registry"} offset ${scrape_interval}, 0))[$__interval:${scrape_interval}]))

spec.description: Which nodes are being chosen as seeds, per interval.
spec.title: Seed Pull Orders by Node

spec.expr: sum by (result) (sum_over_time((clamp_min(angryduck_worker_pulls_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", registry=~"$registry"} - angryduck_worker_pulls_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", registry=~"$registry"} offset ${scrape_interval}, 0))[$__interval:${scrape_interval}]))

spec.description: Registry pulls executed by seed workers, per interval. cancelled = a slow seed was stopped and the node got the image from a peer.
spec.title: Seed Pulls by Result

spec.expr:
sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_pull_seconds_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result="success", registry=~"$registry"}[30m]))
/ sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_pulls_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result="success", registry=~"$registry"}[30m]))

spec.description: Seconds per successful registry pull over the preceding 30 minutes, per node. Pulls only happen when an image is pushed, so a short window left isolated fragments; a gap now means no pull for 30 minutes.
spec.title: Average Seed Pull Duration (30m rolling)

spec.expr: sum by (registry) (sum_over_time((clamp_min(angryduck_worker_pulls_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result="success", registry=~"$registry"} - angryduck_worker_pulls_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result="success", registry=~"$registry"} offset ${scrape_interval}, 0))[$__interval:${scrape_interval}]))

spec.description: Successful registry pulls per registry, per interval. Empty unless METRICS_LABEL_REGISTRY=true.
spec.title: Seed Pulls by Registry

spec.description: How seeds were ranked: layers (bytes already held) or a fallback (repo, utilization). Fallbacks usually mean a manifest couldn't be read.
spec.title: Seed Ranking Basis

spec.description: Bytes of the latest seeded image each seed lacked when ordered, i.e. what it had to fetch from the registry. Only set when layer ranking was used.
spec.title: Registry Download per Seed

spec.description: Node/image pairs currently in ImagePullBackOff or ErrImagePull, as seen by the rescuer.
spec.title: Images Stuck

spec.description: Registry pulls running now (line) and slow seeds cancelled in favour of a peer per interval (red).
spec.title: Seed Pulls in Flight & Timeouts

spec.description: Distinct blob digests and snapshot chainIDs the controller tracks across all nodes. Used for layer-based seed ranking.
spec.title: Layer Index Size

spec.expr: sum by (image) (angryduck_controller_propagation_nodes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", image=~"$image", state="have"}) / sum by (image) (angryduck_controller_propagation_nodes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", image=~"$image", state=~"have|missing|in_flight|seeding"})

spec.description: Every image currently being spread: share of eligible nodes that already have it, and node counts per state. Click an image to focus the tab on it.
spec.title: Propagation Progress

spec.description: Nodes per propagation state across the selected images. Zero while nothing is being propagated.
spec.title: Nodes by State

spec.description: complete: every eligible node has the image. superseded: a newer tag of the same repo was pushed. expired: PROPAGATE_WINDOW_S ran out.
spec.title: Finished Propagations

spec.description: Peer-to-peer transfers ordered by the propagator, per interval.
spec.title: Transfers by Result

spec.description: Which nodes received propagated images, per interval.
spec.title: Transfers by Receiving Node

spec.description: Per interval: success / failure, or why no attempt was made: no_source (no node has the image), no_target, pull_policy_always.
spec.title: Rescue Decisions

spec.description: Node and image pairs whose rescue has failed repeatedly. Click a node to focus on it.
spec.title: Failing Rescues

spec.description: Rescues the controller is running right now.
spec.title: Rescues in Flight

spec.description: Pushed images currently being spread across the fleet.
spec.title: Active Propagations

spec.expr: sum by (reason, result) (sum_over_time((clamp_min(angryduck_worker_rescues_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"} - angryduck_worker_rescues_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"} offset ${scrape_interval}, 0))[$__interval:${scrape_interval}]))

spec.description: Images workers fetched from peers, per interval: for a stuck pod (rescue) or after a push (propagate). already_present = nothing to do.
spec.title: Peer Fetches by Reason & Result

spec.description: Bytes moved between nodes (blobs and compressed snapshots) for rescue and propagation. Received up, served down.
spec.title: Transfer Throughput

spec.description: The 10 nodes serving the most bytes to peers.
spec.title: Top Senders

spec.description: present: already unpacked here. blob: verified compressed layer. snapshot: shipped directory (last resort). Per interval.
spec.title: Layers by Delivery Method

spec.description: Share of shipped layers that had to go as snapshots over the preceding 30 minutes. High values usually mean discard_unpacked_layers = true. A gap means nothing was shipped for 30 minutes.
spec.title: Snapshot Share of Shipped Layers (30m rolling)

spec.description: Snapshots shipped by a rescue that are still pinned against garbage collection, kept for a retry until RESCUE_PIN_TTL_S.
spec.title: Pinned Snapshots

spec.description: Leftovers removed per interval: temp_snapshot / temp_image from an interrupted rescue, or expired_pin.
spec.title: Leftover Cleanups

spec.description: Requests per second containerd sent to the node mirror. local: from this node. peer: streamed from another node. miss: containerd went to the registry.
spec.title: Mirror Requests by Result

spec.expr:
sum by (kind) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result=~"local|peer"}[30m]))
/ sum by (kind) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[30m]))

spec.description: Share of mirror requests served inside the cluster over the preceding 30 minutes, weighted by request count: overall (solid) and per content kind (dashed). The mirror only sees traffic while containerd pulls, so a short window has nothing to divide during quiet periods; a gap here now means no pulls for 30 minutes. Guides at 70 % and 90 %.
spec.title: Mirror Hit Ratio (30m rolling)

spec.description: Bytes the mirror delivered to containerd by source (up) and bytes this fleet served to other nodes' mirrors (down). Every delivered byte is one not downloaded from the registry.
spec.title: Mirror Bytes

spec.description: Share of containerd's mirror requests served inside the cluster (local or peer) over the selected time range.
spec.title: Mirror Hit Ratio

spec.expr: sum by (node) (sum_over_time((clamp_min(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result="miss"} - angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result="miss"} offset ${scrape_interval}, 0))[$__interval:${scrape_interval}])) > 0

spec.description: Requests per interval that no node in the cluster could serve, so containerd went to the registry, stacked per node. No bar means no misses in that interval. Nodes with the biggest totals are the ones preheat and propagation are missing.
spec.title: Mirror Misses per Node

spec.description: Orange while a node is above GC_HIGH and not yet back to GC_LOW. Click a row to focus on that node.
spec.title: Disk-Pressure Cleanup per Node

spec.description: Per interval. old: unused past GC_UNUSED_FOR_S. pressure: removed early because the disk was above GC_HIGH. rollback: one of the newest per repo, removed as a last resort. error: removal failed.
spec.title: Images Removed by Tier

spec.description: Images that could be removed right now. pressure and rollback candidates are only removed while a node is cleaning.
spec.title: Removal Candidates by Tier

spec.expr: sum by (node) (sum_over_time((clamp_min(angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier!="error"} - angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier!="error"} offset ${scrape_interval}, 0))[$__interval:${scrape_interval}]))

spec.description: Which nodes are removing the most images, per interval (errors excluded).
spec.title: Images Removed per Node

spec.description: Across all images being spread: nodes that have it, are missing it, are receiving it, are still seeding, or were skipped. Zero while nothing is being propagated.
spec.title: Propagation Nodes by State

spec.description: Images each node can't pull right now (pods in ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull). Should drop back to zero as rescues land.
spec.title: Stuck Images per Node

spec.expr:
(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
+ (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

spec.description: Bytes delivered from inside the cluster instead of the registry over the selected time range: mirror hits plus peer transfers received.
spec.title: Registry Bytes Avoided

spec.description: Nodes whose disk is above GC_HIGH and not yet back to GC_LOW.
spec.title: Nodes Cleaning

spec.description: Bytes per second delivered from inside the cluster instead of the registry: mirror hits served from the node itself or a peer, plus images received from peers for rescue and propagation.
spec.title: Bytes Kept Off the Registry

spec.expr:
sum by (kind) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result=~"local|peer"}[30m]))
/ sum by (kind) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[30m]))

spec.description: Share of mirror requests served inside the cluster over the preceding 30 minutes, weighted by request count: overall (solid) and per content kind (dashed). The mirror only sees traffic while containerd pulls, so a short window has nothing to divide during quiet periods; a gap here now means no pulls for 30 minutes. Guides at 70 % and 90 %.
spec.title: Mirror Hit Ratio (30m rolling)

spec.description: Images each node can't pull right now (pods in ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull). Should drop back to zero as rescues land.
spec.title: Stuck Images per Node

spec.description: Registries seed pulls came from. Empty unless METRICS_LABEL_REGISTRY=true.
spec.label: Registry
spec.name: registry

spec.description: Images currently being propagated. Tip: click an image in the progress table to set this.
spec.label: Image
spec.name: image

title: Angry Duck

spec.description: Prometheus data source that scrapes the Angry Duck controller and workers.
spec.label: Data source
spec.name: datasource

spec.description: Cluster (k8s_source_cluster). "All" also matches setups without that label.
spec.label: Cluster
spec.name: cluster

spec.description: Nodes to show. Tip: click any node name in a table or chart to set this.
spec.label: Node
spec.name: node

spec.description: Scrape interval of the Angry Duck ServiceMonitors. Event counts are summed scrape by scrape, so this must match (deploy/*/servicemonitor-*.yaml uses 15s).
spec.name: scrape_interval
